article.story: FAIRFAX, Va. -- — Darius Maddox totaled 18 points to guide George Mason to a 77-70 victory over Massachusetts on Saturday. Maddox went 7 of 15 from the field (2 for 7 from 3-point range) for the Patriots (12-5, 3-1 Atlantic 10 Conference). Brayden O'Connor had 11 points and Jared Billups pitched in with 10 points and six rebounds. The Minutemen (6-11, 1-3) were led by Rahsool Diggins with 21 points. Jaylen Curry added 15 points and Marqui Worthy scored 13. George Mason took the lead with 10:49 to go in the first half and never looked back. The score was 36-32 at halftime, with Maddox racking up nine points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
